target.title: fix(ui): explain replace-mode filtering in model picker
target.body:
Closes #104545

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with `models.mode: "replace"` would see only explicitly configured models in the Control UI without any explanation, making newly bundled or discovered models appear unsupported.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing replace-mode filtering remains unchanged. Configured model-list responses now carry additive `catalogMode: "replace"` metadata, and the chat model picker plus Quick Settings use it to show a localized explanation with a direct "Manage models" action. Full-catalog (`view: "all"`) responses do not carry the hint metadata.

## User Impact

Users can immediately tell that their local replace-mode configuration is filtering the catalog and can open model settings to add models or change the catalog mode, instead of debugging upstream model support.

## Evidence

- Exact-head refresh: rebased onto `main` at `17630226fc`; pushed head `f414fbb2547`.
- Focused Gateway and UI regressions: 6 files, 299 tests passed.
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/models.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-state.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.test.ts ui/src/pages/config/quick.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/models.test.ts`
- Browser regression: `ui/src/e2e/chat-composer-redesign.e2e.test.ts`, 7 tests passed with the repository's UI E2E Vitest config.
- Exact-head deterministic visual proof against a mocked `chat.metadata` replace-mode response:
  - desktop 1280x900: hint and action visible; menu contained within viewport; no horizontal overflow
  - mobile 393x852: 369px menu contained within viewport; hint wraps cleanly; no horizontal overflow
- Focused `oxfmt` and type-aware `oxlint` passed for all touched source and test files.
- The final diff retains the two new keys only in `ui/src/i18n/locales/en.ts`; non-English bundles and `.i18n` metadata match current `main`. The expected two pending fallback keys remain for authenticated post-merge `control-ui-locale-refresh` handling per `ui/AGENTS.md`.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.

Before: the configured model rows were shown with no indication that replace mode hid other catalog entries.

After: the picker and Quick Settings state, "Replace mode shows only models explicitly listed in Settings," with a "Manage models" action.

Crabbox was unavailable in this checkout, so visual proof used the repository's deterministic Control UI mock gateway and local Chromium fallback. The same repository UI E2E Vitest config was run directly and passed.

Exact-head local Codex autoreview was attempted. The configured model requires a newer CLI, and the supported-model fallback was rejected by local approval policy because it would export the unpublished diff/repository context to an external service.

AI-assisted: Codex was used to implement and review this change. No agent transcript is attached.

target.title: fix(qa-lab): close transport before gateway teardown
target.body:
Closes #106005

## What Problem This Solves

QA Smoke scenarios can finish successfully while Crabline transport work is still delivering an HTTP response. The suite stopped the gateway first, so that in-flight delivery became an unhandled `HTTP response closed before delivery completed` rejection.

The rebased branch also inherited a current-main architecture failure: the new read-only shared-state database boundary was missing from the raw SQLite guardrail allowlist.

## Why This Change Was Made

Close the transport before stopping the gateway. Transport cleanup drains outstanding provider HTTP work while the gateway can still accept delivery. The cleanup-order regression test preserves that ordering even when cleanup reports an error.

Allowlist `openclaw-state-db-readonly.ts` alongside the existing state database lifecycle boundaries. It intentionally opens a read-only connection without joining writable schema repair, journal setup, checkpoints, or permission mutation.

## User Impact

QA Smoke no longer reports a post-success unhandled rejection caused by its own teardown order. Runtime behavior outside QA Lab is unchanged.

## Evidence

- Exact-head architecture gate on `b0893f4203e7352d83f6c12c999be388a44abc3d`: passed, including Kysely guardrails and database-first legacy-store checks.
- Exact-head focused QA extension suite: 29 passed.
- Exact-head QA smoke on the QA Lab gateway plus `qa-channel` transport: `channel-chat-baseline` passed 1/1; output reached `CRABBOX_PHASE:complete` with `TEARDOWN_REJECTION:absent`.
- Remote proof ran from content-verified source synced to DigitalOcean Crabbox (`provider=digitalocean`, lease `cbx_16a7892bd40b`, Node 24.18, public networking, Tailscale disabled); the lease was deleted after validation.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh autoreview reported no accepted or actionable findings.

## Limitations

The full extension test-type project was not green locally because current main had unrelated iMessage nullability errors during the initial repair. The exact-head remote proof above covers this PR's changed behavior and the CI failure repaired here.

target.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure
target.body:
## Summary
- split requester wake success from visible message-tool delivery status for subagent completions
- preserve requester/parent wake when required group/channel visible delivery fails to produce message-tool evidence
- persist visible delivery failure details and mark linked detached task delivery as failed instead of delivered

## Why
For group/channel subagent completions, visible replies must still go through the message tool. When that visible delivery fails, the requester/parent wake should remain visible to orchestration instead of becoming a passive `pendingFinalDelivery` dead letter. The visible failure also must not be reported as successful task delivery.

This keeps the safety policy intact while preserving parent continuation and making task delivery accounting honest.

## Contract note
This PR intentionally uses terminal split semantics: requester wake can be credited as delivered while required visible message-tool delivery is recorded as failed. It does not add a fallback direct-send path and does not bypass message-tool policy.

If maintainers prefer required visible output to remain bounded and retryable after requester wake succeeds, I can revise this PR around that contract instead.

## Real behavior proof
**Behavior addressed:** subagent completion delivery where requester/parent handoff runs but the required group/channel visible reply does not produce message-tool evidence.

**Current PR head tested:** `c58c79aeb8786c375d179c516e9599f9492aae56`

**Real environment tested:** local OpenClaw source checkout on this clean PR branch, using exact-head source regression tests for the patched subagent delivery, lifecycle cleanup, detached-task delivery accounting, and SQLite registry restore behavior.

**Exact steps or commands run after this patch:**

```bash
./node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.test.ts
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.ts src/agents/subagent-announce-dispatch.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.types.ts
git diff --check
```

**Evidence after fix:**

```text
Vitest: 6 files passed / 418 tests passed
tsgo core: passed
tsgo core test: passed
oxfmt touched files: passed
git diff --check: passed
```

**Observed result after fix:** focused exact-head coverage verifies that requester wake is recorded as delivered, required visible delivery is marked failed, visible-delivery error metadata is persisted, pending delivery is cleared during cleanup, linked detached task delivery status is set to failed, cleanup replay preserves restored terminal failed delivery, and SQLite restore preserves failed status plus requester-wake/visible-failure metadata.

**What was not tested:** this proof did not send a live Slack/Discord message to an external channel. It intentionally uses exact-head local source regression coverage for the requester wake, visible failure, task-delivery status, cleanup replay, and SQLite restore paths without posting to a real workspace.

## Tests
- `./node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/agents/subagent-announce-delivery.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry-lifecycle.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.store.sqlite.test.ts` — 6 files / 418 tests passed
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo` — passed
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo` — passed
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1` on changed files — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed

## Notes
- This clean rewrite drops the release-owned `CHANGELOG.md` change and unrelated CI/script commits from the previous branch state.
- Scope stays narrow: no retry framework, no fallback direct-send behavior, no governed-execution semantics.
